subject: Re: Draft MAP - Data handling & compliance milestones (retention, logging, PHI/PII)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Morales <elenam@acmehealth.com>, Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & initial MAP draft - data handling + compliance milestones

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our call, I’m attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan focused on the data handling and compliance milestones we discussed. I’ve pulled out the near-term items you asked for so we can validate responsibilities and a target close date for procurement. Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Data_Compliance_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Redwood_SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf (summary of evidence we can share).

High-level milestones (please confirm edits):
- M1: Define retention windows and data classification (Target owner: Acme IT / Assignee: Elena) — target complete: 2026-03-12
- M2: Logging & audit trails scope (Target owner: Acme Security / Assignee: Tom) — target complete: 2026-03-19
- M3: PHI/PII constraints & redaction plan (Target owner: Acme Compliance / Assignee: Elena) — target complete: 2026-03-19
- M4: KMS key-handling + encryption at rest confirmation (Target owner: Redwood / Assignee: Rishi Malhotra) — target complete: 2026-03-05
- M5: BAA / legal review and redlines (Target owner: Acme Legal) — dependency: procurement committee; target complete: 2026-03-26
- M6: SOC2 evidence exchange & audit schedule (Target owner: Redwood / Assignee: Vivek Kulkarni) — target complete: 2026-03-12

Dependencies noted in the spreadsheet: procurement committee sign-off (BAA/legal), Acme security contact to confirm logging retention policy, and a brief technical handoff for KMS integration.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Elena: confirm the owner for M1 and whether the 30/90/180 retention buckets in the spreadsheet match Acme policy (reply by 2026-03-02 if possible)
2) Tom: confirm scope for audit logs (which events you need retained and retention length) — I’ve left a short checklist in the MAP for you to mark
3) Rishi (cc’d): I’ll need a short statement on KMS options we support and any steps for key management integration (I’ll draft tasks once you confirm)
4) Proposed next call: Tue 2026-03-02 10:00 AM PT to finalize M1–M4 if that works for you both

Quoted for context: notes from today’s call are embedded in the MAP.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel

Redwood Inference

From: Dr. Elena Morales <elenam@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & initial MAP draft - data handling + compliance milestones

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear draft. A few quick items from our side after reviewing the MAP attachment: 

- Confirmed: Acme Compliance will own M1 and M3 (Retention & PHI/PII redaction). I’ll be the point for the retention buckets but I’ll also loop in our data governance SME (external contact: data-gov@acmehealth.com) for details.
- For M2 (logging & audit trails) we need the logs to include: access events, model input hashes (not raw inputs), system admin actions, and tokenized access markers. Retention preference: 1 year for access logs, 3 years for admin/audit trails depending on legal triggers — we can flex but procurement will want clarity.
- BAA: We must have a BAA in place before any PHI processing. Please add an explicit MAP milestone for BAA signature with legal contacts and procurement timeline. I’ve attached Acme_PHIPolicy_v2.docx for your reference.

Timeline looks OK but procurement approval will likely push M5 to end of March — recommend we mark M5 as 2026-03-31 as a conservative target and track procurement gating separately in the MAP.

Happy to join the Tuesday call; please send calendar invite.

Best,
Elena
Dr. Elena Morales
Head of Compliance, Acme Health Systems
elenam@acmehealth.com | +1 212-555-0147

[attachment: Acme_PHIPolicy_v2.docx]

Updated items
- M1: Ownership set to Acme Compliance (Elena) — retention buckets column expanded (30/90/365) — please confirm which events map to each bucket
- M2: Logging events added per Elena’s list; default retention proposed (1y access / 3y admin) — Tom please confirm or propose alternates
- M3: PHI/PII redaction — added explicit requirement to store only input hashes when possible; redaction techniques and redline examples included in the MAP comments
- M4: KMS + encryption — Rishi to provide a short integration checklist (Rishi: can you confirm asymmetric vs. symmetric KMS approach we recommend and any HSM/KMS attestation we can provide?)
- M6: SOC2 evidence exchange — Vivek to own delivery of the evidence package and a short note on what we can share immediately vs. under NDA

Action items assigned in updated MAP v1.1:
- Elena: confirm retention buckets and owners on the sheet (due 2026-03-05)
- Tom: confirm log event list and retention (due 2026-03-05)
- Rishi: KMS checklist and integration notes (due 2026-03-04)
- Vivek: SOC2 evidence share plan and preliminary evidence (due 2026-03-08)

Procurement note: Tom / Elena, I captured a procurement gating item — Acme procurement committee review + legal redlines (BAA) — which will be the primary dependency for the final procurement signature. I also added a HubSpot deal link and a Drive folder (links below).

Proposed next call confirmed for Tue 2026-03-02 10:00 AM PT — I’ll send an invite.

Thanks —
Monica

Got it and thanks for the quick updates. I agree with the plan and the updated targets. A couple of procurement/process notes from my side:
